title: Device latency & cost curation and certification for model variants
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Goal: create a repeatable curation and certification workflow that produces validated device-specific performance artifacts for our supported SKUs (A100, H100, L40S, MI300). Deliverables: 1) a canonical perf-profile JSON schema emitted by onboarding CI, 2) an automated certification job that runs microbenchmarks + representative prompts to produce latency P50/P95/P99, throughput/QPS, GPU memory footprint, and cost-per-1k-tokens estimates, 3) human review checklist and guardrails for releasing a profile into the model catalog, and 4) fallback mapping rules (e.g., map H100-lowmem variant -> L40S-compatible when H100 unavailable). This ticket focuses on the engineering pieces required to produce trustworthy profiles and wire them into the runtime and console release process.
comments: 2026-02-15 Sofia Chen: Created ticket after triage with PM. Outline agreed: focus on canonical metrics, CI harness, and human-in-the-loop certification. POC targets A100/H100 first, then extend to L40S/MI300.

2026-02-18 Marco Ruiz: Started prototype of perf harness. Implemented tokenized throughput runner and KV-cache warmup sequence. Observed large variance on long-sequence tests on MI300; adding more warmup iterations.
2026-02-22 Priya Nair (PM): Reviewed success criteria. Add cost-per-1k estimate using cloud SKU pricing + amortized GPU-hour; must be labeled as estimate vs. billing-exact.

2026-02-25 Design review (Alex Morgan): Suggested a separate 'device-certification' badge in the console with hover text explaining test corpus and QC thresholds. Need assets from console team; opening cross-team task.

2026-02-28 Marco Ruiz: CI job uploaded initial artifacts to S3 (link above). Benchmark harness measures P50/P95/P99, throughput under 256/512 token windows, peak GPU memory, and 95th percentile CPU utilization on host. Added reproducibility note in readme.

2026-03-02 Sofia Chen: Security asked to confirm no model weights are leaked into artifacts; confirming harness produces only performance metrics and aggregated logs. Security OK'd quick review - no secrets in artifacts.

2026-03-05 Internal review (runtime team): Edge case found: when a model uses custom attention kernels, the kernel selector returns different code paths on MI300 vs H100 causing 2x latency for short sequences. Action: add kernel-whitelist per-model to profile schema and flag as 'non-portable'.

2026-03-07 Marco Ruiz: Implemented profile schema v1.1 with fields: device, sequence_buckets, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, throughput_tps, mem_bytes_peak, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, kernel_compatibility, artifact_link. Schema is JSON-LD-like but emitted as flat JSON for runtime ingestion. Pushed PR #2197.

2026-03-08 QA (Linh Tran): Ran acceptance on dedicated pool. Found that fallback mapping incorrectly selected L40S when H100 low-memory variant should be used. Raised bug ENG-11429-B1 and hotfixed mapping table in runtime routing layer.

2026-03-10 Marco Ruiz: Incorporating feedback from Console team for UI text. Preparing release notes and a short runbook for SRE on how to interpret profile regressions (dashboard alert thresholds). Planning canary publish in runtime-1.22 next Wednesday.

Follow-ups: 1) Add synthetic prompt suite that mirrors customer prompt length distribution (PM to provide sample sets). 2) Automate merging of profile PRs only after a human certification sign-off comment. 3) Extend harness to include quantized model runs for cost estimates.
